name: gbrain-aio
description: GBrain all-in-one for Unraid: a hosted knowledge base and MCP server for AI agents (Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Codex). One container runs GBrain, PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, Caddy TLS, and the job supervisor. Agents connect over HTTPS — Postgres is never exposed. First run (details are in each field's help text): 1. Set Postgres Password and Admin Bootstrap Token. 2. Set LAN Bind and Public URL to your host IP. 3. Set Brain Path to an empty folder. 4. Start, then open https://lan:3132/admin/ and paste the token. 5. Trust the generated CA once.

paths.name: Appdata Root
paths.description: Single persistent folder. Sub-folders are created automatically: data/postgres (database), gbrain-home (config, OAuth, runtime.env), caddy (TLS certs + CA).

paths.name: Brain Path
paths.description: Host path to the brain markdown repo. Mounted at the fixed target /source/brain; the source id is fixed to 'brain'. Should be an empty folder (or a git repo) that GBrain will initialize.

variables.name: Postgres User
variables.description: Postgres superuser. Keep gbrain.

variables.name: Postgres Password
variables.description: REQUIRED. Alphanumeric only (A-Za-z0-9). Secret. Example: mypass123. Generate: head -c 16 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '+/=' | head -c 16

variables.name: Postgres DB
variables.description: Postgres database name. Keep gbrain.

variables.name: LAN Bind
variables.description: Your Unraid host LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50). The container binds HTTPS to this IP. This is local-network only, not a public address.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Optional. Empty = derived from LAN Bind (https://LAN Bind:3132). Override only for custom port, DNS-name access, reverse proxy, or a Tailscale origin. Must match how clients actually reach the container.

variables.name: Admin Bootstrap Token
variables.description: First /admin login token. Must be 32+ chars, alphanumeric + _-. Secret. Generate: head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '+/=' | head -c 48

variables.name: Brain UID
variables.description: UID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default is 99 (nobody). Keep 99 unless you know otherwise.

variables.name: Brain GID
variables.description: GID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default is 100 (users). Keep 100 unless you know otherwise.

variables.name: Ollama Base URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for embeddings + chat. Point at your local Ollama. Example: http://192.168.1.50:11434/v1 (replace with your Ollama host IP). Leave empty to skip local Ollama.

variables.name: Chat Model
variables.description: Chat model name used when OLLAMA_BASE_URL is set. Written as together:this name. Leave the default unless you know another model. Empty Ollama URL means no chat model (keyword/embed-or-skip).

variables.name: Brain Git Push URL
variables.description: Optional. After a successful autopilot-cycle, push the mounted brain to this remote. Empty = off. Do not point a test copy at a live canonical remote. The token is not stored in the remote URL.

variables.name: Brain Git Push Token
variables.description: Optional. Masked token for Brain Git Push URL. Empty = unauthenticated push. Never pasted into git remote -v.

variables.name: Doctor Remediate Max USD
variables.description: Optional. Weekly doctor exam always runs. Set a number to also run gbrain doctor --remediate --max-usd N for that run's estimate. Empty = exam only. Not a weekly wallet.

variables.name: Skillopt Enabled
variables.description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable cycle.skillopt.enabled.

variables.name: Nightly Quality Probe
variables.description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable autopilot.nightly_quality_probe.enabled.

variables.name: Parser Probe Enabled
variables.description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable autopilot.conversation_parser_probe.enabled.

variables.name: OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables OpenRouter models (any provider:model id). Secret.

variables.name: Anthropic API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables Claude models for chat/think. Secret.

variables.name: Chat Provider
variables.description: Empty or ollama = route chat/expansion through the ollama recipe (raw gbrain, zero-cost). together = legacy provider_base_urls redirect kept for compatibility. Only used when Ollama Base URL is set.

variables.name: Extra Runtime Config
variables.description: Universal escape hatch. Comma-separated key=value pairs for ANY gbrain config key (e.g. models.drift=ollama:deepseek-v4-flash:cloud, dream.triage.threshold=0.6). provider_base_urls is refused. Applied after known defaults; explicit entries win.

variables.name: Extra Runtime Env
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated KEY=VALUE pairs passed to the runtime environment. Allowlist-only: GBRAIN_EMBEDDING_MULTIMODAL(_MODEL), GBRAIN_EMBEDDING_IMAGE_OCR(_MODEL), GBRAIN_SEARCH_EXCLUDE, GBRAIN_SOURCE_BOOST, GBRAIN_CHAT_FALLBACK_CHAIN, GBRAIN_BACKUP_CHECK(_DAYS), GBRAIN_AUTOPILOT_LABEL, GBRAIN_TRAJECTORY_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD, GBRAIN_EMBED_CONCURRENCY, GBRAIN_RETRIEVAL_REFLEX_*. Anything else is refused at boot.

variables.name: Embedding Model
variables.description: Empty = ollama:embeddinggemma. Any provider:model id supported by gbrain init.

variables.name: Embedding Dimensions
variables.description: Empty = 768. Must match the embedding model native width (e.g. bge-m3=1024, nomic=768).

variables.name: Schema Pack
variables.description: Empty = gbrain-everything. Schema pack id passed to gbrain schema use.

variables.name: Autopilot Interval
variables.description: Empty = 1800 seconds. Seconds between autopilot cycles.

variables.name: Dream Time
variables.description: Empty = 02:00 local. HH:MM for the nightly dream cycle.

variables.name: Doctor Day
variables.description: Empty = monday. Weekday for the weekly doctor exam (mon|tue|...).

variables.name: Doctor Time
variables.description: Empty = 06:00. HH:MM for the weekly doctor run.

variables.name: Tailscale Origin Policy
variables.description: Empty = auto when Unraid per-container Tailscale is enabled (origin = MagicDNS name). off = keep LAN origin. Any URL = explicit origin. Public URL override wins over this.

variables.name: Cert Extra DNS
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated extra DNS names for the TLS cert SAN (e.g. your MagicDNS name). Empty = only base SAN plus auto-discovered tailnet names.

variables.name: Cert Extra IPs
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated extra IPs for the TLS cert SAN (e.g. 100.x.y.z)

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables OpenAI models for chat/embeddings. Secret.

variables.name: Google Gemini API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables Google Gemini models. Secret.

variables.name: DeepSeek API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables DeepSeek models. Secret.

variables.name: Groq API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables Groq models. Secret.

variables.name: Voyage API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables Voyage embeddings/rerank. Secret.
